caption: The drawing depicts a figure with three human heads aligned side by side at the top of a single body. Each head features black hair and a full black beard, with similar facial features and expressions. The body is dressed in a garment colored red with vertical black stripes and a black belt at the waist. Both arms are visible and bent at the elbows, with light skin coloration on the hands and forearms. A chain with several links, shown in a brownish-gold color, is draped across the arms and torso, connecting both wrists. The lower part of the figure is drawn as a single, solid black pedestal or base, which appears roughly textured. The background is a plain off-white, and the style is flat and illustrative with visible brush strokes and shading. In the bottom right corner, the text "MITCHEL G. CHAPLIN - TAOS - N. M." is written in small letters.
